thesis: The page is the lake-effect forecast map of Onondaga County: every section is a pin under a snow band, and the band sweeps south across the page as you scroll until it settles over your street.

signature.name: Lake-Bearing Pin & Drift Band
signature.summary: A brick pin chip with a wide-caps place label and a mono compass bearing whose arrow points to Lake Ontario, riding on a 14-degree hatched diagonal snow band whose offset follows scroll so it drifts from the lake side to the south. Hero: drawn county map, three bands, eight pins drop lake to south, street plate clipped to the city pin. Story: pinned map zooms to Eastwood, Tipp Hill, Liverpool with house cut-aways whose leak arrows seal. Services: pin cards with mini bands at different angles. Reviews: on a county strip map at their town pin. ZIP: lights the town pin. Form: ends on your street pin. Footer: county map with the band parked at the bottom.

palette.family: Ontario Lake Blue + Snowbank + Tipp Hill Brick + Porch Yellow

layoutMoves: Hero: lake-blue field, drawn county SVG map fills the right 7 columns, h1 sits on the lake area top-left, street plate (hero-C3, 4:5) clipped to the city pin and overlapping the map edge
Every section header is a pin chip + bearing on a diagonal drift band that crosses the section seam (bands cut across boundaries, never horizontal)
Pinned zoom story on desktop: map left 6 cols, neighbourhood cut-away + copy right; stacked cards under 900px
Reviews laid on a horizontal county strip map, cards hang from their town pins at different heights
Rhythm: field -> paper -> mid -> deep -> paper -> field -> paper -> deep footer, never two darks touching

motion.intro: Shoreline draws (500ms), three drift bands slide in from the lake (80ms stagger), eight pins drop lake to south (60ms stagger, 8px, no bounce); 1.1s total, text static from frame 0, skipped under reduced motion.
stories: zoom: pinned map tweens county to Eastwood, Tipp Hill, Liverpool; each step draws the area's house cut-away and seals its leak arrows one by one
drift: --sw-p moves every drift band's offset so the snow band travels down the page
motion.hover: Pin lift: card or pin rises 3px and its bearing arrow turns 14 degrees toward the lake, 200ms ease-out.
